datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data on a monthly schedule throughout 2019, classifying geographic areas by acute food insecurity phase. The data represents spatial projections of food insecurity conditions in Ethiopia, with multiple scenarios and collection dates spanning February through December 2019.
